lines: Composer; Alton H. Howard
He took my burdens all away,
Up to a brighter day,
He gave me a song, a wonderful song;
A wonderful song I now can sing,
In my heart joy bells ring,
He gave me a song, a wonderful song.
Brighter the way grows ev'ry day,
Walking the heav'nly way,
He gave me a song, a wonderful song;
A wonderful song I now can sing,
Praises to him, my King,
He gave me a song, a wonderful song.
I am redeemed no more to die,
Never to say "good-bye,"
He gave me a song, a wonderful song;
And some of these days in that fair land,
Sing with the chorus grand,
He gave me a song, a wonderful song.
He gave me a song to sing about,
He lifted me from sin and doubt,
Oh, praise his name, He is my King,
A wonderful song, He is to me.
